headline: Integra Essentia Limited announces rights issue at ₹145 per share
sum: Integra Essentia Limited's board approved a rights issue in the ratio 161:250 (161 new shares for every 250 held), priced at ₹145 per equity share. The offer was announced to the NSE on 14 May 2026.
implication: Rights issues in India require SEBI approval under Rule 13 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Rules, 2018; track compliance with preferential allotment timelines and shareholder approval thresholds under the Companies Act, 2013.
detail: Integra Essentia Limited's Board of Directors, at a meeting on 14 May 2026, resolved to issue equity shares on a rights basis. The issue ratio of 161:250 means that for every 250 equity shares held by a shareholder, 161 new shares will be offered. The issue price was set at ₹145 per share. The company notified the NSE of this decision via formal stock exchange disclosure, which triggers mandatory SEBI approval and shareholder consent requirements under the ICDR Rules. The exact size of the offer (total number of shares and gross proceeds) was not disclosed in the board notification.
